issues.title: Decide: command alias resolution boundary
issues.description: Catalog-owned alias resolution with immutable aliases and atomic collision rejection.
issues.closeReason: Chosen: catalog-owned resolution. Commands declare immutable aliases; registration rejects all canonical-name and alias collisions before mutation.

prompt: /wb:create_tasks docs/plans/2026-09-01-command-aliases. Follow every numbered skill step, including the mandatory single task batch and complete coordinator-owned Beads hierarchy. Plan only the approved design. Read the effective project config from the repository root, never from inside docs/plans; it sets task.softRequestBudget to 90. Preserve status, current_phase, total_tasks, and completed_tasks exactly for /wb:update_status: use surgical edit hunks that leave their original frontmatter lines outside every edited range; never replace or retype those lines. Do not write tasks.md until every final Beads id exists. Preserve the immutable TypeScript contract exactly as `aliases?: readonly string[]`. Registration validation and lookup consume the shared alias type but not each other's output; each behavioral task owns its focused test changes in test/catalog.test.ts, so their source and test allowed files overlap. Serialize them explicitly as file-overlap serialization in both the plan and dependent Beads issue. Do not create a later test-only task that duplicates those focused scenarios. Use only verification commands supported by package.json.
